page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 7T83 processors running at 2.55 GHz. The physical layout consists of 32 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores ranking in the top 25%. The AMD EPYC processor delivers strong performance in cryptography and extended instructions, as evidenced by high PassMark encryption and database operation scores. Memory bandwidth for small, cached blocks is highly efficient, though uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average tier. Single-threaded tasks, such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, show average performance, while multi-threaded decompression and ray tracing workloads perform in the top tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated hardware allocation provides predictable compute performance without resource contention, making it a viable option for enterprise workloads requiring high resource density. The balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio and strong database benchmark results make this instance well-suited for relational databases, multi-threaded data processing, containerized microservices, and medium-scale web serving. It is also capable of handling lightweight machine learning tasks, such as prompt processing and text generation for small LLM models, though performance scales down for larger models.
